/* ------------- BUTTON SHINE ANIMATION ------------ */
.glow-button {
position: relative;
overflow: hidden;
/* keep shine inside */
box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) !important;
}

/* Shine effect layer */
.glow-button::after {
content: "";
position: absolute;
top: -50%;
bottom: -50%;
left: -60%;
right: -60%;
background: linear-gradient(
50deg,
rgba(255,255,255,0) 40%,
rgba(255,255,255,0.6) 50%,
rgba(255,255,255,0) 60%
);
transform: translateX(-80%);
pointer-events: none;
/* button still clickable */
display: block;
animation: shine 3s infinite alternate;
/* runs forever */
z-index: 0;
}

/* Keep button text above the shine */
.glow-button > * {
position: relative;
z-index: 1;
}

/* animation keyframes */
@keyframes shine {
from {
transform: translateX(-120%);
}

to {
transform: translateX(120%);
}
}
/* ------------- BUTTON SHINE ANIMATION ------------ */
.popup-container {
max-width: 100%;
overflow-x: hidden;
/* optional: center it */
margin: 0 auto;
}

}

/* 1) Center slides */
.logo-showcase-container.mobile-single-logo
.slide-logos.logo-showcase-content {
display: flex !important;
justify-content: center !important;
align-items: center !important;
}

/* 2) Define the logo SLOT size (THIS is the key) */
.logo-showcase-container.mobile-single-logo a.logo-item,
.logo-showcase-container.mobile-single-logo picture.hl-image-picture {
width: min(320px, 90vw) !important;
max-width: 320px !important;
height: 320px !important;
display: block !important;
margin: 0 auto !important;
}

/* 3) Make the image fill the slot */
.logo-showcase-container.mobile-single-logo img.logo-item-image {
width: 100% !important;
height: 100% !important;
max-width: none !important;
object-fit: contain !important;
display: block !important;
}

/* ------------- BUTTON SHINE ANIMATION ------------ */
.glow-button {
position: relative;
overflow: hidden;
/* keep shine inside */
box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) !important;
}

/* Shine effect layer */
.glow-button::after {
content: "";
position: absolute;
top: -50%;
bottom: -50%;
left: -60%;
right: -60%;
background: linear-gradient(
50deg,
rgba(255,255,255,0) 40%,
rgba(255,255,255,0.6) 50%,
rgba(255,255,255,0) 60%
);
transform: translateX(-80%);
pointer-events: none;
/* button still clickable */
display: block;
animation: shine 3s infinite alternate;
/* runs forever */
z-index: 0;
}

/* Keep button text above the shine */
.glow-button > * {
position: relative;
z-index: 1;
}

/* animation keyframes */
@keyframes shine {
from {
transform: translateX(-120%);
}

to {
transform: translateX(120%);
}
}
/* ------------- BUTTON SHINE ANIMATION ------------ */
.popup-container {
max-width: 100%;
overflow-x: hidden;
/* optional: center it */
margin: 0 auto;
}


/* ------------- checkout lines to green ------------ */

.form-heading.active {
color: #38a169 !important;
}

.divider-form {
background-color: #38a169 !important;
}

.divider-form .fa-caret-up {
color: #38a169 !important;
}




/* Turn all underlined text into a rounded highlight */
.heading-4nnuDdqivB3 strong {
text-decoration: none !important;
/* Remove default underline */
font-weight: 700;
background-color: #0038FF !important;
/* Highlight color */
border-radius: 4px;
/* Rounded corners */
padding: 1px 3px;
/* Nice, tight highlight padding */
color: #fff !important;
/* Makes text readable on blue */
}

/* ------------- icon ------------ */
.my-icon {
filter: brightness(0) saturate(100%) invert(39%) sepia(91%) saturate(3554%) hue-rotate(343deg) brightness(95%) contrast(96%);
}

.my-arrow {
filter: brightness(0) saturate(100%) invert(88%) sepia(2%) saturate(128%) hue-rotate(169deg) brightness(92%) contrast(86%);
}




/* ------------- underline ------------ */

.heading-4nnuDdqivB3 u {
text-decoration-color: #0038FF !important;
}

/* ------------- green icons square ------------ */
.numbersicons {
aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
display: grid;
/* center content */
width: 50px;
place-items: center;
/* center content */
}

/* ------------- popup stuff ------------ */
#hl_main_popup-rZxqipmC59 {
z-index: 99999 !important;
}

.popupcontainer {
overflow: hidden;
}

.closeLPModal {
display: none !important;
}</style><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Lato:100,100i,200,200i,300,300i,400,400i,500,500i,600,600i,700,700i,800,800i,900,900i%7COpen%20Sans:100,100i,200,200i,300,300i,400,400i,500,500i,600,600i,700,700i,800,800i,900,900i%7CMontserrat:100,100i,200,200i,300,300i,400,400i,500,500i,600,600i,700,700i,800,800i,900,900i%7CRoboto:100,100i,200,200i,300,300i,400,400i,500,500i,600,600i,700,700i,800,800i,900,900i%7CLora:100,100i,200,200i,300,300i,400,400i,500,500i,600,600i,700,700i,800,800i,900,900i%7CDancing%20Script:100,100i,200,200i,300,300i,400,400i,500,500i,600,600i,700,700i,800,800i,900,900i%7CPoppins:100,100i,200,200i,300,300i,400,400i,500,500i,600,600i,700,700i,800,800i,900,900i%7CRoboto%20Mono:100,100i,200,200i,300,300i,400,400i,500,500i,600,600i,700,700i,800,800i,900,900i%7CInter:100,100i,200,200i,300,300i,400,400i,500,500i,600,600i,700,700i,800,800i,900,900i%7CRoboto:100,100i,200,200i,300,300i,400,400i,500,500i,600,600i,700,700i,800,800i,900,900i&display=swap" media="print" onload="this.media='all'"><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://stcdn.leadconnectorhq.com/intl-tel-input/17.0.12/css/intlTelInput.min.css"><style>.form-XGWD5ARCFC #_builder-form label{ color:#0D0D0DFF }</style><style>.form-XGWD5ARCFC #_builder-form { /* ------------- BUTTON SHINE ANIMATION ------------ */

<!-- CSS -->
<style>
/* General Reset */
body {
font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
margin: 0;
padding: 0;
background: #f9f9f9;
overflow-x: hidden; /* Prevent horizontal scrolling */
}

/* Wrapper */
.my-review-carousel-wrapper {
position: relative;
width: 100%;
max-width: 440px;
margin: 0 auto;
padding: 0 30px; /* Space for arrows */
box-sizing: border-box;
overflow: hidden; /* Prevent overflow */
}

/* Inner Container */
.carousel-inner {
padding: 20px 0; /* Vertical padding for shadows */
overflow: visible;
}

.carousel-wrapper {
display: flex;
transition: transform 0.5s ease-in-out;
position: relative;
z-index: 2; /* Ensure slides are on top */
}

.review-card {
flex: 0 0 calc(100% - 40px); /* Adjust for manual gaps */
margin: 0 20px; /* Gaps between slides */
background: #fff;
padding: 20px;
box-sizing: border-box;
text-align: left;
border-radius: 12px;
box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); /* Shadow around slides */
}

/* Profile Picture */
.profile-picture {
width: 50px !important; /* Ensures fixed width */
height: 50px !important; /* Ensures fixed height */
border-radius: 50% !important; /* Forces round shape */
object-fit: cover !important; /* Ensures proportions are maintained */
margin-right: 10px !important; /* Adds spacing */
}

/* Review Header */
.review-header {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.google-logo {
width: 25px;
height: auto;
margin-left: auto;
}

.reviewer-name {
font-weight: 600;
font-size: 14px;
color: #333;
}

.review-date {
font-size: 12px;
color: #aaa;
}

.review-stars {
display: flex;
margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.star {
width: 20px;
height: 20px;
}

.review-content {
color: #333;
font-size: 14px;
}

/* Arrows */
.carousel-arrow {
position: absolute;
top: 50%;
transform: translateY(-50%);
font-size: 24px;
font-weight: 200;
color: #ddd;
cursor: pointer;
user-select: none;
opacity: 0.2;
z-index: 1; /* Lower z-index to place behind slides */
}

.left-arrow {
left: 25px;
}

.right-arrow {
right: 25px;
}

.carousel-arrow:hover {
color: #ccc;
}

/* Progress Bar */
.carousel-progress {
width: 40%; /* Adjusted width */
max-width: 300px;
margin: 5px auto;
height: 2px;
background: #e0e0e0; /* Inactive progress bar */
position: relative;
border-radius: 2px;
overflow: hidden; /* Prevent bleed */
}

.progress-slice {
width: calc(100% / 3); /* Divide into thirds */
height: 100%;
background: #bbb; /* Default grey */
position: absolute;
left: 0;
transition: transform 0.3s ease-in-out;
}

.progress-active {
width: calc(100% / 3); /* Highlighted active section */
height: 100%;
background: #888; /* Slightly darker grey */
position: absolute;
left: 0;
transition: transform 0.3s ease-in-out;
pointer-events: none; /* Avoid blocking touches */
}

/* Rating Summary */
.rating-summary {
text-align: center;
margin-top: 10px;
font-size: 14px;
color: #333;
padding-right: 10px; /* Right padding */
padding-left: 10px; /* Left padding */
}
</style>
<!-- JavaScript -->
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
const carouselWrapper = document.getElementById("carouselWrapper");
const slides = document.querySelectorAll(".review-card");
const progressSlice = document.querySelector(".progress-slice");
const prevArrow = document.getElementById("prevArrow");
const nextArrow = document.getElementById("nextArrow");
const progressBar = document.querySelector(".carousel-progress");

const totalSlides = slides.length;
let currentIndex = 0;

const slideWidth = slides[0].offsetWidth + 40; // Slide width + gap

let startX = 0;
let isDragging = false;
let autoScroll;

/** Update Carousel */
function updateCarousel() {
const offset = -currentIndex * slideWidth;
carouselWrapper.style.transition = "transform 0.3s ease-in-out";
carouselWrapper.style.transform = `translateX(${offset}px)`;
updateProgress();
}

/** Update Progress Bar */
function updateProgress() {
const progressBarWidth = progressBar.offsetWidth; // Actual width of progress bar
const stepSize = progressBarWidth / totalSlides; // Width of each "step"
const position = currentIndex * stepSize; // Calculate position based on current slide
progressSlice.style.transform = `translateX(${position}px)`;
}

/** Reset Auto-Scroll */
function resetAutoScroll() {
clearInterval(autoScroll);
autoScroll = setInterval(() => {
if (currentIndex < totalSlides - 1) {
currentIndex++;
} else {
currentIndex = 0;
}
updateCarousel();
}, 4500);
}

/** Arrow Clicks */
prevArrow.addEventListener("click", () => {
if (currentIndex > 0) {
currentIndex--;
updateCarousel();
resetAutoScroll();
}
});

nextArrow.addEventListener("click", () => {
if (currentIndex < totalSlides - 1) {
currentIndex++;
} else {
currentIndex = 0; // Loop back to the first slide
}
updateCarousel();
resetAutoScroll();
});

/** Touch Swipe */
carouselWrapper.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
isDragging = true;
startX = e.touches[0].clientX; // Record starting touch point
carouselWrapper.style.transition = "none";
clearInterval(autoScroll); // Pause auto-scroll on swipe
});

carouselWrapper.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => {
if (!isDragging) return;
const currentX = e.touches[0].clientX;
const moveX = currentX - startX;
const offset = -currentIndex * slideWidth + moveX;
carouselWrapper.style.transform = `translateX(${offset}px)`;
});

carouselWrapper.addEventListener("touchend", (e) => {
isDragging = false;
const endX = e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
const diffX = startX - endX;

if (diffX > 50 && currentIndex < totalSlides - 1) {
// Swipe left
currentIndex++;
} else if (diffX < -50 && currentIndex > 0) {
// Swipe right
currentIndex--;
}
updateCarousel();
resetAutoScroll();
});

/** Initialize */
window.addEventListener("resize", updateProgress); // Update progress bar on resize
resetAutoScroll();
updateCarousel();
});
</script></div><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----></div><!--]--><!--]--></div><!----><!----><!----><!----><span></span><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----></div><!--]--><!--]--></div><!----><!----><!----><!----><span></span><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----></div><!--]--><!--]--></div><!----><!----><!----><!----><span></span><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----><!----></div><!--]--><!--[--><div <!-- 🔧 STYLES -->
<style>
#avoid-mistake-box {
font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
background: #fff1f1;

font-size: 14px;

</style>

<!-- ⚙️ SCRIPT -->
<script>
const mistakeMessages = [
"❌ Months lost, $0 made",
"😂 Watching IG reels for ‘inspiration’",
"⏳ Every delay = Someone else gets paid",
"🫤 Friends succeeding… you’re still thinking",
"❌ No money, no confidence",
"🙄 She’s still ignoring you",
"🚫 Another year gone, still broke"
];

const mistakeBox = document.getElementById("avoid-mistake-text");
const boxWrap = document.getElementById("avoid-mistake-box");

let mIndex = 0;

function rotateMistake() {
boxWrap.style.opacity = 0;

setTimeout(() => {
mIndex = (mIndex + 1) % mistakeMessages.length;
mistakeBox.textContent = mistakeMessages[mIndex];
boxWrap.style.opacity = 1;
}, 400);
}

// Initial delay before first change
setTimeout(() => {
rotateMistake();
// Start interval AFTER first delayed rotation
setInterval(rotateMistake, 2500);
}, 3000); // Wait 4s before first switch
</script>

<div style="display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;width:100%;">
<div id="simple-universal-timer-a" aria-live="polite" role="timer">00:43:00</div>
</div>

<style>
#simple-universal-timer-a {
font-family: "Roboto Mono", "Courier New", monospace;
font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
-webkit-font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1;
font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1;
font-weight: 600;
color: #0038ff;
font-size: 40px;
line-height: 1;
letter-spacing: 0.02em;
min-width: 9ch;
padding: 6px 8px;
box-sizing: content-box;
text-align: center;
}
</style>

<script>
(function(){
const el = document.getElementById('simple-universal-timer-a');
if (!el) return;

const pad2 = n => String(n|0).padStart(2,'0');
const fmt = sec => {
sec = Math.max(0, Math.floor(sec));
const h = pad2(Math.floor(sec/3600));
const m = pad2(Math.floor((sec%3600)/60));
const s = pad2(sec%60);
return `${h}:${m}:${s}`;
};
const render = sec => { el.textContent = fmt(sec); };

window.addEventListener('universalCountdownTick', e => {
render(e.detail.remainingSec);
});

const uc = window.UNIVERSAL_COUNTDOWN;
if (uc && Number.isFinite(uc.endMs)) {
render(Math.max(0, Math.floor((uc.endMs - Date.now())/1000)));
} else {
const stored = +localStorage.getItem('uc_end_ms');
if (stored > 0) render(Math.max(0, Math.floor((stored - Date.now())/1000)));
}
})();
</script>

<div style="display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;width:100%;">
<div id="simple-universal-timer-b" aria-live="polite" role="timer">00:43:00</div>
</div>

<style>
#simple-universal-timer-b {
font-family: "Roboto Mono", "Courier New", monospace;
font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
-webkit-font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1;
font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1;
font-weight: 600;
color: #0038ff;
font-size: 40px;
line-height: 1;
letter-spacing: 0.02em;
min-width: 9ch;
padding: 6px 8px;
box-sizing: content-box;
text-align: center;
}
</style>

<script>
(function(){
const el = document.getElementById('simple-universal-timer-b');
if (!el) return;

const pad2 = n => String(n|0).padStart(2,'0');
const fmt = sec => {
sec = Math.max(0, Math.floor(sec));
const h = pad2(Math.floor(sec/3600));
const m = pad2(Math.floor((sec%3600)/60));
const s = pad2(sec%60);
return `${h}:${m}:${s}`;
};
const render = sec => { el.textContent = fmt(sec); };

window.addEventListener('universalCountdownTick', e => {
render(e.detail.remainingSec);
});

const uc = window.UNIVERSAL_COUNTDOWN;
if (uc && Number.isFinite(uc.endMs)) {
render(Math.max(0, Math.floor((uc.endMs - Date.now())/1000)));
} else {
const stored = +localStorage.getItem('uc_end_ms');
if (stored > 0) render(Math.max(0, Math.floor((stored - Date.now())/1000)));
}
})();
</script>

<style>
:root{
--primary:#0038ff;
--surface:#ffffff;
--text-hi:#000000;
--text-lo:#444444;
--border:#d8d8d8;
--pill-bg:rgba(0,56,255,.06);
--bar-bg:rgba(0,0,0,.06);
--accent:#0038ff; /* countdown digits */
--font-ui:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
--font-head:"Poppins",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
--r-lg:12px;
--r-pill:999px;
}

.urgX{display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:0px}
.urgX-wrap{
-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
font-family:var(--font-ui);
box-sizing:border-box;
width:100%;
max-width:700px;
margin:0 auto;

color:var(--text-hi);
border:1px solid var(--border);
border-radius:var(--r-lg);
padding:10px 12px;
display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;
box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
}

.urgX-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.urgX-left{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:0}

.urgX-title span{

}

.urgX-nums{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;font-size:14px}
.urgX-chip{

padding:4px 8px;line-height:1;border-radius:var(--r-pill);
background:var(--pill-bg);color:var(--text-hi)
}
.urgX-chip--ok{
background:rgba(0,56,255,.08);
border:1px solid rgba(0,56,255,.4);
color:#0038ff;
font-weight:600;
}
.urgX-sep{color:var(--text-lo)}

.urgX-pill{
white-space:nowrap;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;
background:rgba(0,56,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(0,56,255,.15);
padding:6px 10px;border-radius:var(--r-pill)
}
.urgX-count{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;padding-left:4px;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}

.urgX-progress{position:relative;height:8px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:var(--bar-bg);overflow:hidden}
.urgX-bar{
height:100%;
background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--primary),#001e99);
border-radius:var(--r-pill);
box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,56,255,.3);
transition:width .6s ease
}

.urgX-activity{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:var(--text-lo);font-size:13px}

@media (min-width:680px){
.urgX-title span{font-size:15px}
.urgX-nums{font-size:15px}
.urgX-pill,.urgX-activity{font-size:14px}
}
</style>

<script data-cfasync="false" src="/cdn-cgi/scripts/5c5dd728/cloudflare-static/email-decode.min.js"></script><script>
(function(){
const pad2 = n => String(n|0).padStart(2,'0');
const fmt = sec => {
sec = Math.max(0, Math.floor(sec));
const h = pad2(Math.floor(sec/3600));
const m = pad2(Math.floor((sec%3600)/60));
const s = pad2(sec%60);
return `${h}:${m}:${s}`;
};
const clamp = (x,a,b)=>Math.min(b,Math.max(a,x));
const toInt = (v,f)=>{ const n=parseInt(v,10); return Number.isFinite(n)?n:f; };

document.querySelectorAll('.urgX').forEach(root=>{
const total = toInt(root.dataset.total,50);
const initClaimed = clamp(toInt(root.dataset.initialClaimed,0),0,total);
const durSec = toInt(root.dataset.duration,2580); // must match your global duration

const countEl = root.querySelector('.urgX-count');
const barEl = root.querySelector('.urgX-bar');
const claimedEl = root.querySelector('.urgX-claimed');
const leftEl = root.querySelector('.urgX-leftnum');
const actTxt = root.querySelector('.urgX-actTxt');

function renderFromRemaining(remainingSec){
// clamp remaining to [0, durSec] so progress stays 0..1 during the current cycle
const rem = clamp(remainingSec, 0, durSec);
const progress = 1 - (rem / durSec);

// claimed/left based on progress
const claimed = clamp(Math.round(initClaimed + (total - initClaimed) * progress), 0, total);
const left = Math.max(0, total - claimed);

if (claimedEl) claimedEl.textContent = `${claimed} claimed`;
if (leftEl) leftEl.textContent = `${left} left`;
if (barEl) barEl.style.width = ((claimed/total)*100).toFixed(1) + '%';
if (countEl) countEl.textContent = fmt(rem);

if (actTxt) {
if (left <= Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total*0.05))) actTxt.textContent = 'Almost gone…';
else if (left <= Math.ceil(total*0.2)) actTxt.textContent = 'Selling out quickly…';
else actTxt.textContent = 'Spots are selling fast…';
}
}

// Live: drive entirely from the universal tick
window.addEventListener('universalCountdownTick', e => {
renderFromRemaining(e.detail.remainingSec);
});

// Initial paint from current endMs (no intervals)
const uc = window.UNIVERSAL_COUNTDOWN;
let initialRem = 0;
if (uc && Number.isFinite(uc.endMs)) {
initialRem = Math.max(0, Math.floor((uc.endMs - Date.now())/1000));
} else {
const stored = +localStorage.getItem('uc_end_ms');
if (stored > 0) initialRem = Math.max(0, Math.floor((stored - Date.now())/1000));
}
renderFromRemaining(initialRem);
});
})();
</script>
